base_experiment: EXP-TOPTAIL-RANK01 R2 (hybrid loss: SmoothL1 + top-tail pairwise)
changed_variable: loss only: R2's SmoothL1+pairwise surrogate REPLACED by a single masked full-memory Oracle-Choice Cross-Entropy loss (predict the Set Oracle's actual argmax next choice directly)

arms.C0: R2 (SmoothL1 + pairwise) + cosine UtilityHead + FROZEN B0 encoder -- existing EXP-TOPTAIL-RANK01/R2 checkpoint, reused verbatim, not retrained
arms.D1: Oracle-Choice CE ONLY (no SmoothL1, no pairwise) + cosine UtilityHead + FROZEN B0 encoder (same B0 checkpoint) -- new training this experiment

scope.tau: 0.1 (= base checkpoint's own tau_topk, no sweep)

sanity_checks: PASSED (tests/test_exp_oracle_choice01.py, 4/4: (1)+(2) full-memory masked CE includes every valid candidate, invalid probability exactly 0; (3) oracle label == argmax(true dense utility); (4) synthetic small-N positive control fits >90% oracle choice accuracy; (5) dense_utility chunking does not change logits/argmax/loss)

pretraining_diagnostic.name: one-hot target near-tie diagnostic (scripts/diag_oracle_margin01.py)
pretraining_diagnostic.purpose: interpretation only -- does NOT change the loss in response to what it finds, per the pre-registered spec
pretraining_diagnostic.finding: near_tie_frac rises from 8.5% at t=1 to 99.0% at t=10; rel_margin_mean falls from 0.136 to 0.0008 -- the Oracle's true top-1 vs top-2 utility margin becomes vanishingly small at later steps, meaning one-hot CE targets become increasingly ill-posed/noisy as the selected set grows. Recorded as a LIMITATION in REPORT.md, not acted on (no automatic switch to multi-positive/soft/KL targets).

notable_training_behavior: D1's val_overlap@10 IMPROVED EVERY SINGLE EPOCH through all 10 epochs trained (0.0119->0.0146, best_epoch=10, the max configured epochs) -- unlike every prior scorer/loss/encoder arm this session (R1, R2, C1, C2, E1, E2), all of which peaked at epoch 1 and declined. D1 never triggered early stopping.
